name: The Minstrel's Wedding (bugs hidden in text only)

nodes.title: Court of the Shah
nodes.description: Aydan the minstrel sings a mocking song about the Shah in front of the whole court. The Shah turns to you: 'Deal with him.'

nodes.title: Silence the Minstrel
nodes.description: You throw Aydan into the dungeon beneath the palace. Three weeks later the jailer reports that he died of fever in his cell.

nodes.title: Pardon the Minstrel
nodes.description: You pay Aydan's fine yourself. Grateful, he swears to sing at every great feast of the realm.

nodes.title: The Caravan Road
nodes.description: Raiders are harrying the trade caravans on the road along the Kura river.

nodes.title: Burn the Bridge
nodes.description: You set fire to the old stone-and-timber bridge over the Kura. It collapses into the river and the raiders are cut off for good.

nodes.title: Hold the Bridge
nodes.description: You and the caravan guards hold the old bridge over the Kura until the raiders give up.

nodes.title: The Lost Crown
nodes.description: In the raiders' abandoned camp you find the Shah's lost wedding crown.

nodes.title: The Royal Wedding
nodes.description: The Shah crowns his bride with the recovered crown while Aydan the minstrel performs the wedding song before the whole court.

nodes.title: Return to the Coast
nodes.description: The wedding caravan heads home, crossing the old bridge over the Kura river at sunset.
